definitions.explanation: A number avoided because it is thought to bring bad luck, in Japan chiefly 4 and 9.

examples.japanese: {忌|い}み{数|かず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。

⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧や⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{忌|い}み{数|かず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧4や9⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}わない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Hospitals and hotels sometimes leave the unlucky numbers 4 and 9 out of their room numbers.

notes:
4 can be read し like ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death), and 9 can be read く like {苦|く} (suffering). Hence gifts are not given in sets of four, and some buildings skip room 4 or 9.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忌|い}み{数|かず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid unlucky numbers

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{迷信|めいしん}→迷信：09212_meishin⟧: superstition
- ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: unlucky, a bad omen
- {忌|い}み{言葉|ことば}: taboo words (avoided at weddings and funerals)
